content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to create a digital storefront without the constraints imposed by traditional payment platforms. This infrastructure is crucial for creators in regions where platforms like Gumroad, with its 10% fee per sale, are inaccessible. By leveraging GitHub Pages, you can set up a fully operational digital product store that supports cryptocurrencies, which have become a preferred method of transaction in many areas due to their low fees and global accessibility. This approach ensures that you retain more of your earnings, enhancing the viability of your digital business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages store is built on several key components. First, your product files are stored on GitHub, allowing for easy management and version control. Automated delivery can be achieved through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which handle the processing of orders and delivery of digital products. When a customer makes a purchase using cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments, the transaction is confirmed on-chain, triggering a webhook that automates the delivery process. This seamless integration of hosting, payment processing, and product delivery creates a robust system that operates independently of traditional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who need an alternative to traditional payment processing systems that often exclude them. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, this solution enables you to bypass the high fees associated with platforms like PayPal and Gumroad. By utilizing GitHub Pages, you create a sovereign digital storefront that enhances your brand and puts you in control of your revenue. This approach is ideal for creators in developing markets who are looking for a sustainable way to monetize their digital products.
Retain 99.5% of your sales revenue with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this system include GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Each element plays a vital role in ensuring the store operates smoothly. GitHub Pages provides a reliable and free hosting solution, while the automated delivery services ensure that customers receive their products instantly. NOWPayments facilitates transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a global audience without the burden of high fees. Together, these components create a powerful digital commerce stack that is both cost-effective and efficient.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store using GitHub Pages, start by creating a GitHub account and setting up a new repository dedicated to your products. Next, upload your digital files to the repository. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for order processing, ensuring they are set up to communicate with NOWPayments for payment verification. Once everything is configured, test the entire process to confirm that purchases trigger automatic product delivery. Finally, promote your store using social media and other channels to reach potential customers. With the Complete Builder Kit available for $197, you have access to all the blueprints and templates necessary to streamline this process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency payments. This combination allows you to avoid high transaction fees and retain more revenue. By automating product delivery with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can create a seamless purchasing experience for your customers.
Automate your digital product delivery for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for ways to sell digital downloads without traditional platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers a comprehensive solution. It includes everything you need to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can set up a digital product store using GitHub Pages and accept cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments. This way, you avoid the limitations of PayPal.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Yes, by leveraging GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for payment processing, you can sell templates and fonts effectively without Gumroad.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments offers low transaction fees at only 0.5%, supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, and requires no KYC, making it a flexible payment solution for digital products.
How can I automate product delivery?
You can automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which will send your digital products directly to customers upon successful payment.
